chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid, al-Sayqal, Abu Ja'far. He has a book regarding the Imamate. My father reported it to us from al-'Attar, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Abi Zahir, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, by it.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far (a common kunya/nom de plume)
key_terms.الصَّيْقَلُ: Al-Sayqal (a kunya or nickname meaning the polisher/coppersmith)
key_terms.الْإِمَامَةِ: The Imamate (doctrine of religious and political leadership)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Sayqal and what is his chain of narration?
ai.summary: This entry from the book of al-Du'afa (or similar biographical works) identifies Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn 'Umar ibn Yazid, known as al-Sayqal and Abu Ja'far, as the author of a book on the Imamate. It provides his specific chain of transmission (isnad) linking him to the source material.
